title: KILLA – Cola
description: Killa Cola Nicopods are all-white nicotine pouches with a strong nicotine content of no less than 16mg/g per pouch. This product, much like the KILLA range, is aimed at experienced users. If you enjoy the refreshing taste of cola, then you should try KILLA Cola. These pouches are 100% tobacco-free and contain only nicotine and cellulose extracted from the tobacco plant.
